scope: Ironclad87, Silent88, Colorless64 source-card crosswalk. This records inspection and regression scope, not complete behavioral certification.
limitations: Shared hooks, nested asynchronous child choices, multiplayer, and all card/relic/power combinations are not exhaustively cross-validated against the live executable.
Version-pinned source comparison is independent evidence; public source provenance cannot authenticate the installed game build.
Single-player combat generation excludes MultiplayerOnly cards through the source pool registry.

remaining_observed_gaps.beacon_of_hope: Generic trigger requires card-origin Block; C# listens to all owner-turn Block gains and applies half to each other player.
remaining_observed_gaps.believe_in_you: Existing energy primitive grants the local player energy; C# grants the targeted other player energy.
remaining_observed_gaps.coordinate: Existing status primitive applies local permanent Strength; C# applies temporary Strength to targeted other player.
remaining_observed_gaps.demonic_shield: Local HP loss executes, but giving the selected other player calculated owner Block is absent.
remaining_observed_gaps.huddle_up: Local draw executes; corresponding draws for all other players are absent.
remaining_observed_gaps.intercept: Local Block executes; CoveredPower routing of attacks aimed at another player is absent.
remaining_observed_gaps.lift: Existing Block primitive grants local Block; C# grants Block to selected other player.
remaining_observed_gaps.rally: Local Block executes; Block gains for every other player are absent.
remaining_observed_gaps.tag_team: Attack executes; TagTeamPower extra play for next attack by another player is absent.
